positions.name: AsyncJobRememberContract
positions.frame: what does the ratified async job contract guarantee about remember's immediate return and how the extraction gets tracked afterward?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the same ratified contract from two angles: src-1 is the ratifying declarative naming the guarantees themselves (receipt in seconds, no blocking call, no lost work), src-2 is a restatement of the operational mechanism that follows from those guarantees (dispatch, then poll-or-piggyback), framed by the speaker as the key decision. Read together they describe one settled contract — the guarantee side and the mechanism side of the same design — with no tension between them, just complementary grain.
